tools.name: get_my_tasks
tools.description: Get tasks scoped to the authenticated user role. Employees see own tasks; Team Leaders see department tasks; CEO/Admin see company tasks.

tools.name: get_team_tasks
tools.description: Get tasks for a specific team member (Team Leader and above only). Enforces company isolation.

tools.name: search_tasks
tools.description: Full-text search across task titles, descriptions, projects, and assignees within the authenticated user's authorized scope.

tools.name: get_task_details
tools.description: Get complete task details including subtasks, timeline, and work history. Access limited to authorized tasks.

tools.name: get_subtask_details
tools.description: Get subtask details. Access validated against parent task authorization.

tools.name: get_task_report
tools.description: Get task status summary report scoped to the user's role and company.

tools.name: get_overdue_tasks
tools.description: Get list of overdue tasks within the user's authorized scope.

tools.name: get_team_report
tools.description: Get workload analytics by employee. Scoped by role (Team Leader: department; CEO/Admin: company).

tools.name: get_subtask_report
tools.description: Get subtask progress summary across parent tasks.

tools.name: get_deadline_requests
tools.description: Get deadline extension requests and their review status.

tools.name: get_project_report
tools.description: Get project-level task totals, status distribution, and completion rates.

tools.name: get_daily_work_report
tools.description: Get daily work update summary for the authenticated user or their team.

tools.name: get_company_report
tools.description: Get company-wide task and performance overview. CEO/Admin only.

tools.name: get_employee_performance
tools.description: Get individual employee performance metrics. Access scoped by role.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create a new task. Enforces company and role-based assignment validation.

tools.name: update_task_status
tools.description: Update task status. User must be assigned to or authorized for the task.

tools.name: update_daily_task
tools.description: Submit or update a daily work update entry for an authorized task.
